tips: Type cc instead of claude to skip all permission prompts
Prefix ! to run bash inline: !git status, !npm test
Esc stops Claude. Esc+Esc rewinds to any checkpoint.
Tell Claude to run tests after changes for 2-3x quality boost
Add ultrathink to any prompt for harder reasoning problems
Use @filename to skip Claude searching — point it directly
Use /btw for side questions without polluting main context
Run /clear between unrelated tasks — fresh context wins
Paste raw error logs directly, not your description of them
Use --worktree to run 3-5 parallel Claude sessions at once
Ctrl+S stashes your draft prompt while you ask something quick
Ctrl+B backgrounds long bash tasks so Claude keeps working
Use subagents for deep investigations to keep main context clean
Plan Mode (Shift+Tab) before any multi-file or unfamiliar work
After 2 failed fixes on same thing, /clear and reprompt
Ctrl+G edits Claude's plan before it writes a single line
Run /init to generate CLAUDE.md then cut the result in half
After a mistake say: update CLAUDE.md so this won't happen again
Use .claude/rules/ for rules that only apply to certain file types
Use @imports in CLAUDE.md to reference docs without bloating it
Allowlist safe commands with /permissions to stop repeat prompts
Use /sandbox for risky or experimental autonomous work
Use /loop to poll deploys or CI while you focus elsewhere
Run /voice and hold Space to dictate richer prompts hands-free
Switch models mid-session: /model opus for hard, haiku for fast
